review_note: Preserves the four equivalent local-ring criteria, including exactly one closed point, existence of a unique maximal ideal with units outside, and nonzero ring plus x or 1−x a unit. The nonzero condition is retained.
statement:
Let $R$ be a ring. The following are equivalent:
\begin{enumerate}
\item $R$ is a local ring,
\item $\Spec(R)$ has exactly one closed point,
\item $R$ has a maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$
and every element of $R \setminus \mathfrak m$
is a unit, and
\item $R$ is not the zero ring and for every $x \in R$ either $x$
or $1 - x$ is invertible or both.
\end{enumerate}

review_note: Preserves equivalence of local-ring-map definition, image of maximal ideal containment, inverse-image equality, and reflection of units, explicitly requiring both R and S local.
statement:
Let $\varphi : R \to S$ be a ring map. Assume $R$ and $S$ are local rings.
The following are equivalent:
\begin{enumerate}
\item $\varphi$ is a local ring map,
\item $\varphi(\mathfrak m_R) \subset \mathfrak m_S$,
\item $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak m_S) = \mathfrak m_R$, and
\item for any $x \in R$, if $\varphi(x)$ is invertible in $S$, then $x$
is invertible in $R$.
\end{enumerate}

is invertible in $R$.
\end{enumerate}

review_note: Preserves all five image-of-Spec criteria for prime p⊂R, including nonzero residue-field tensor, two localized quotient expressions and p=φ^{-1}(pS). No criterion is dropped or reversed.
statement:
Let $\varphi : R \to S$ be a ring map. Let $\mathfrak p$
be a prime of $R$. The following are equivalent
\begin{enumerate}
\item $\mathfrak p$ is in the image of
$\Spec(S) \to \Spec(R)$,
\item $S \otimes_R \kappa(\mathfrak p) \not = 0$,
\item $S_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak p S_{\mathfrak p} \not = 0$,
\item $(S/\mathfrak pS)_{\mathfrak p} \not = 0$, and
\item $\mathfrak p = \varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak pS)$.
\end{enumerate}
